summary: Executed backend pytest regression (public endpoint) and frontend Playwright flow checks for auth, role-protected routes, CRUD shells, audit logs, and exchange mock execution.

integration_issues.flow: Exchange mock execute -> events table refresh
integration_issues.issue: In one run, execute returned success but table row count stayed 0 immediately after submit; subsequent diagnostic run showed rows present.
In one run, admin audit table rendered with 0 rows immediately after strategy actions; later run returned rows normally.

action_items: Investigate potential race condition/stale state in ExchangeMockPage fetch/refresh sequence after execute.
Add deterministic loading/empty-state handling on AuditLogsPage and ExchangeMockPage so users can distinguish empty data vs delayed fetch.
Optional: resolve passlib bcrypt backend warning seen in backend logs.
critical_code_review_comments: ExchangeMockPage useEffect has missing dependency warning (fetchAll), increasing stale closure/race risk during refresh-heavy flows.
Backend router-level tests are missing in repository by default; keep the added pytest file as regression baseline.
seed_data_creation: Created dynamic test users and multiple TEST_/UI entities through API/UI during validation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend APIs passed 8/8 pytest cases via public URL. Frontend critical paths passed, but exchange/audit table population showed one-time timing inconsistency before stabilizing. Verify with a focused UI re-run after any state-management changes.
rca of the issue: Likely frontend timing/state sync behavior: page reads rows immediately after async mutation and refresh call, while data arrival/render may lag. Mitigation: explicit loading state + awaited refresh completion + robust post-submit polling in UI tests.
